environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with a single rule that applies a RegexPatternSet match on the query string component 'value' — the pattern set contains entries matching common UNION/SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE keywords with case-insensitive flag BUT uses a TextTransformation of URL_DECODE only (no HTML_ENTITY_DECODE or COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK mode and TextTransformations: [URL_DECODE, LOWERCASE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE] applied to query string parameters. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm rule group 3 evaluates on all requests that pass rules 1 and 2.

config.waf_rule_group_2: Custom 'app-input-validation' - RegexPatternSet on 'value' param, URL_DECODE only, patterns: (?i)(union|select|insert|update|delete)
config.waf_rule_group_3: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, ALL rules BLOCK, TextTransformations: [URL_DECODE, LOWERCASE, COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE] on AllQueryArguments
